ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure there are three source containers, labeled respectively as 1 L, 2 L, and 1 L; the temperatures below them are respectively 300 K, 300 K, and 200 K. The three containers are connected by plus signs, and an arrow points to a container on the right side. The target container on the right side is labeled as 4 L, and the temperature below it is 300 K. The problem statement also gives that the initial pressures of the first three containers are all 1.0 atm. Reasoning: Use the ideal gas law n=PV/RT to calculate and add the initial amounts of substance: n_total = (1.0/R)(1/300 + 2/300 + 1/200). After transfer to the right-side 4 L, 300 K container, P_final = n_total R T_final / V_final = [(1.0/R)(1/300 + 2/300 + 1/200)] R(300)/4 = 1.125 atm. Taking appropriate significant figures according to the problem standard, it is about 1.1 atm.

method.method_draft: First describe the image values: identify the three source container volumes and temperatures and the final container volume and temperature. From the text, take that all three starting pressures are 1.0 atm and that their contents are transferred into the right container. Compute the initial moles in each source container using n=PV/RT, add those moles, then use the ideal gas law for the 4 L, 300 K final container to obtain the final pressure, rounded to 1.1 atm.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧有三个源容器，标注分别为 1 L、2 L、1 L；它们下方温度分别为 300 K、300 K、200 K。三个容器之间用加号连接，并由箭头指向右侧一个容器。右侧目标容器标注为 4 L，下方温度为 300 K。题干还给出前三个容器的初始压力均为 1.0 atm。
推理：用理想气体定律 n=PV/RT 计算并相加初始物质的量：n_total = (1.0/R)(1/300 + 2/300 + 1/200)。转移到右侧 4 L、300 K 容器后，P_final = n_total R T_final / V_final = [(1.0/R)(1/300 + 2/300 + 1/200)] R(300)/4 = 1.125 atm。按题目标准取适当有效数字，约为 1.1 atm。

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧有三个气体容器，依次标为 1 L、2 L、1 L；它们下方温度分别标为 300 K、300 K、200 K。三个左侧容器之间用加号连接，并用箭头指向右侧一个较大的容器。右侧容器标为 4 L，下方温度标为 300 K。
推理：题目说明左侧三个容器初始压强均为 1.0 atm，并将内容物转移到右侧 4 L、300 K 的容器中。把每个原容器中的气体看作在最终容器中贡献一个分压，用理想气体关系按体积比和温度比换算：P_final contribution = P_initial × (V_initial / V_final) × (T_final / T_initial)。第一个容器贡献 1.0 × (1/4) × (300/300) = 0.25 atm。第二个容器贡献 1.0 × (2/4) × (300/300) = 0.50 atm。第三个容器贡献 1.0 × (1/4) × (300/200) = 0.375 atm。总压强为 0.25 + 0.50 + 0.375 = 1.125 atm，按题目答案取约为 1.1 atm。
